intervention_label: Confirm DLL3 by IHC (SP347) on tumor — diagnostic gate
expected_benefit: Resolves which scenario applies. Trial NCT06788938 enforces ≥25% (stage 1) or ≥1% (stage 2) by IHC.
key_risks: if negative, the DLL3-targeted pathway is foreclosed
preference_alignment: Aligns with all stated preferences — non-toxic, gates the user-preferred trial option.
guideline_status: Implicit in every modern targeted-therapy guideline; specifically required by NCT06788938.
rationale_summary: All five personas converged on DLL3 IHC as the precondition. RNA expression alone does not establish membrane DLL3; IHC is the standard gating biomarker for every DLL3-directed therapy in current clinical use.
open_questions: Will the SP347 antibody assay be available at the treating institution?

expected_benefit: If mechanism translates from SCLC: median OS 13.6 vs 8.3 mo (HR 0.60) in DeLLphi-304 SCLC; ORR ~40% in DeLLphi-301. Cross-tumor extrapolation to osteosarcoma is unproven — the trial design exists precisely to test this.
key_risks: no prior osteosarcoma data — cross-tumor translation is the open question
preference_alignment: Strong match: high-risk-high-reward + prefers_trials. The biomarker-positive scenario is exactly when this option is on-mechanism.
guideline_status: Off-guideline for osteosarcoma; trial enrollment is NCCN cat-1 for relapsed disease.
rationale_summary: In the IHC-positive branch, conservative's veto LIFTS — its own comment specified the veto was conditional on IHC confirmation. Concensusite endorses on guideline-aligned trial-enrollment principle. The critic's dissent persists (no published osteosarcoma data with tarlatamab; cross-tumor translation unproven), which is honored by the `dissent_by` flag and acknowledged in `key_risks`. Two endorsements from round 1 (risktaker, advocate) plus the post-IHC veto-lift from conservative and qualified-now-endorse from concensusite yield a positive agreement score. Defensible rank-1 in this scenario given the user's stated preferences.

rationale_summary: Strong evidence base persists across scenarios. In the positive branch, ranks below the trial because the user's preferences lift the trial above it; remains the standard if trial enrollment is delayed or contraindicated.
